title: Correct total time
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be 3 seconds.

title: Correct minimum speed
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be 3√2 m/s or approximately 4.24 m/s.

title: Acceleration from friction
description: Important: The student must correctly calculate the block's acceleration as a = μg = 1.5 m/s².

title: Two-stage motion analysis
description: Important: The solution must identify that the block first accelerates to match the belt's speed, then moves uniformly.

title: Condition for minimum time
description: Important: For part (2), the student must recognize that minimum time occurs when the block just reaches speed v at point B (i.e., v² = 2aL).

title: Kinematics for acceleration phase
description: Optional: The student may show the calculation for the time (t1 = v/a) and distance (x1 = v²/(2a)) during acceleration.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly assigns the direction of friction or uses the wrong sign in the force equation.

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the final answer is missing units or uses incorrect units (e.g., m/s for time).
